lines.text: The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children, wishing grace, mercy, and peace from the Father and Jesus.
The elder was overjoyed to find some children walking in the truth, and urges that we love one another.
Many deceivers have gone into the world, refusing to confess Christ's coming in the flesh, and they are antichrists.
Whoever remains in Christ's teaching has the Father and the Son; do not welcome anyone who lacks it.
The elder hopes to speak face to face rather than use paper and ink, so their faith may be complete.
